evidence: The original run 37670744036 recorded a trusted /forms pointer click, then selected:null before selected:Links returned; this supports a race at the next Copy target lookup.

The new bounded readiness poll runs after the open tab closes and before both Links and Video Copy clicks; the subsequent click still passes through the native resource gate and trusted pointer driver.
The prior hosted artifact predates f8c0ad58. No native run of this change was performed by this reviewer.
verdict_a_behavior_source_vs_native.finding: Readiness can return true for a data-matrx-title-only Copy button, but the following scrape-media-copy pointer resolver searches only button[title^="Copy "]. A hover/title transition between open and copy can therefore reproduce pointer_target_not_unique despite a ready verdict. Make both lookups use the same target contract, then perform the guarded native retest.

verdict_b_quality_doctrine.causal_guard: The reported pre-fix run says the new restoration case failed on pointer_target_not_unique and the sibling rejection case failed on a missing rejection; the current node --test run passed 20/20 with zero skipped. The test waits for a scripted second readiness sample, which does exercise the old-versus-new boundary, but it does not expose the title/data-matrx-title mismatch because its fake click checks only the selected tab.
verdict_b_quality_doctrine.timeout_and_diagnostics: waitFor is bounded to 10 seconds and throws scrape_media_copy_target_ready_not_observed with the last readiness state; it does not convert this error to a partial observation. The pointer click retains its own failure diagnostics.
verdict_b_quality_doctrine.video_sibling: observeVideoLinks and observeScrapeLinks share the changed function; the focused restoration test iterates over both. The same selector mismatch affects both.
verdict_b_quality_doctrine.assertion_integrity: No skip or softened verdict was introduced in f8c0ad58; URL mismatch and clipboard mismatch assertions remain failures, and native action errors still abort.
verdict_b_quality_doctrine.finding: Add a focused case with a Copy control carrying only data-matrx-title that proves the readiness result and pointer target selection agree. Current readiness can pass where the pointer driver necessarily finds zero candidates.
